title: Utubaawwan Olka’oo Tuullaa Qilleensaan Harca’an
intro: Qaroomina guddachaa jiruu fi kennaa humna olkaʼaa fi ogummaa ijaarsaa gita hin qabne qabu yaadi. Hawaasni kun, tulluuwwan balʼaa fi qaxxaamuroo taʼan gidduutti kan qubate siʼa taʼu, mallattoolee gurguddaa samii tuqan kaase. Ta’us of tuuluun hidda gadi fageeffatee, waamichi gara ibaadaa Rabbii qofaatti deebi’uuf godhame mormiidhaan simatame. Wanti itti aanu akeekkachiisa qilleensa mataa isaa irratti geggeeffamu ta'ee hafa.
clues: Nuti saba humna guddaa qabu kan ummata Nuh duukaa dhufne, dheerina fi humna guddaa eebbifamne turre.
Bakka olkaʼaa hunda irratti ispoortii fi boonsaa qofaaf masaraawwan ol kaʼoo fi siidaa ijaarre.
Humnaan eenyutu nu caala jennee of jajnee, gara laafina malee irreedhaan sochoone.
Ergamaan keenya Huud yeroo Rabbiin tokkicha gabbaruuf nu waamu, dadhabaa fi sobduu jedhee dinne.
Akeekkachiisa sanatti qoosnee yoo dhugaa dubbate adabbii inni doorsise akka nutti fiduuf mormne.
Halkan torbaa fi guyyaa saddeetiif qilleensi hamaa fi gogaa taʼeen balleessinee, akka jirma muka meexxii qaawwa qabuutti kufnee hafne.

arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَأْفِكَنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: They said, "Have you come to delude us away from our gods? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful." (46:22)
